_why: Owner instruction 2026-10-13: the banner said 'bottom of the ocean' (deep sea only) while the channel carries three domains. Owner refinement the same day: the banner and description are OPEN-ENDED. The tagline names the idea, never a domain list, so a new domain never needs a new banner; the description's one domain line is generated from the channel's domains (loop/channel_branding.py channel_domains()) at apply time. Owner rulings later that day: keep the ORIGINAL logo (visuals/brand.py mark() + the Georgia wordmark, drawn by that code, not a copy) and the original wording minus the deep-sea-only clause; the lines read as one thought, question -> answer -> cadence; vivid cinematic panels under one warm-dark grade with soft fades; three candidates, one applied, switching is one command. A domain without an entry under `domains` is refused by the apply and failed by validator V51.
required_phrases: how we know what we know
applied_why: B: the clearest single subject per panel (a red deep-sea jelly, a forge bar throwing sparks, honey falling in one glossy stream) and the clearest reading order: the question, the answer on the next line in the secondary colour, then the cadence - the original lockup's rhythm at the largest legible size. A's one-line version shrinks the type to fit; C's crystal is busy behind the words.
description_note: The description itself lives in channel/about.md (its one source, with its provenance); its {{DOMAINS}} token is replaced at apply time by every channel domain's `display` below, joined in plain English. loop/channel_about.py and loop/channel_branding.py both read it through channel_about.read_about(), so they can never push two different texts.
